name: Hallway: the API is returning server errors
expression: (sum(rate({otel_metric_name="http.server.request.duration", service_name="hallway-api", deployment_environment_name="hackathon", http_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate({otel_metric_name="http.server.request.duration", service_name="hallway-api", deployment_environment_name="hackathon"}[5m])) > $__threshold

annotations.description: Filter traces to service hallway-api with status ERROR. If /healthz says es: red, Elasticsearch is unreachable. If only /api/matches fails, check whether chaos mode is `error`.
